scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @irrigation/contracts && npm run build -w @irrigation/data && npm run build -w @irrigation/simulator && npm run build -w @irrigation/intelligence
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @irrigation/api && npm run build -w @irrigation/web
